corrections.reason: The 1st order 'ተ' in 'ወዳንተ' (unto you, translating Ge'ez 'ኀቤከ') was misread as 6th order 'ት' due to slight ink fade on the cross-bar.
The line ends with 'ሐዋ' and wraps to 'ርያት' on line 5; Stage 1 hallucinated an extra 'ር' at the end of line 4.
The word is 'እለ' (Andemta idiom 'እለ ስሙ ሕይወት መድኃኒት እንደ ሆነ' = meaning that His name is life and salvation), where the 6th order 'እ' was misread as 1st order 'አ'.
Canonical Ge'ez for Acts 9:30 ('ቢጸ' = the brethren, glossed below as 'ምእመናን'). The 3rd order leg on 'ቢ' and 1st order 'ጸ' were transposed/misread by OCR as 'በጺ'.
